defects.catch_criteria: In src/orchestration/agent-runtime/tools/tool-paths.ts, `recoverMissingPath` returns `healed` for a single same-stem sibling when `siblings.complete && localFits.includes(only)` although the repository-wide basename lookup was incomplete (`complete` is false), so a file with the exact requested name deeper than the lookup reached is a competing meaning that the code never sees, and the call silently picks the sibling. A review catches it only if it says that the local-sibling heal proceeds after an incomplete basename search and can therefore choose between two meanings instead of refusing.
defects.title: Do not treat an incomplete basename search as proof of uniqueness

defects.catch_criteria: In src/orchestration/modules/code-mode/invocation-guest.ts, the `onUnknownTool` hook passed to `CodeMode.execute` turns every result with `outcome: "error"` into a thrown failure, including an error result that the repaired tool itself returned after it ran; a script that calls the exact tool name receives that result as a value, so the same script with a repaired name aborts instead of reaching its own error handling. A review catches it only if it says that a repaired nested call throws on a tool's error result where an exact-name call returns it.
defects.title: Preserve the result contract after repairing a nested tool name
